title: USPS shipping/package volume: 2008 vs 2020 peak (billion pieces)

source.name: USPS Office of Inspector General -- historical mail volume analysis

notes: USPS shipping and package volume more than doubled from 3.3 billion pieces in FY2008 to 7.3 billion pieces in FY2020, driven by e-commerce growth; FY2025 volume was 6.8 billion, still more than double the 2008 level.
